data.name: Habib
data.gender_notes: Habib is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ح-ب-ب (ḥ-b-b), 'to love'. Ḥabīb means 'beloved'. Its root is ح-ب-ب (ḥ-b-b). A common Muslim given name. Habib is a Arabic name meaning “Beloved; dear; darling”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Habib expresses “Beloved; dear; darling”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ح-ب-ب (ḥ-b-b), 'to love'. Ḥabīb means 'beloved'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Habib total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
